_purpose: NIAKOFA CHARACTER + WORLD CALIBRATION SHEET v1 — numbers extracted directly from the Hand_Drawn_Kwame_Mensah.zip and Hand_Drawn_Envirnonment_Assets.zip concept boards' own on-image annotations. This is the standard every future hand-drawn character and environment asset should be validated against before it's accepted into the runtime.

spriteGrid.note: Two of the six Kwame boards state 64x64; one states 'Grid: 64px, Isometric Offset: 32px'. Treat 64x64 as canonical and confirm isometric offset with the artist producing final frames.
